description: 博登杀：弃后引兵，双象交叉将死
explanation_en: White sacrifices the queen to deflect a pawn and open the a6-c8 diagonal, allowing the two bishops to deliver the classic crossfire mate known as Boden's mate.

intro.popup: 💡 博登杀：这就是当年博登持白的经典棋局——突然弃后，用双象交叉将死对方。
intro.popup_en: 💡 Boden's mate: This is the classic game Boden played as White. A sudden queen sacrifice sets up a crossfire checkmate with the two bishops.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qxc6+弃后引黑兵至c6，打开a6-c8对角线，Ba6#双象交叉将死，经典博登杀。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qxc6+ sacrifices the queen and draws a black pawn to c6, opening the a6-c8 diagonal. Ba6# then delivers the classic crossfire mate with the bishops.

moves.popup: 白后弃后Qxc6+！将军，引诱黑兵来吃，打开a6-c8对角线。
moves.popup_en: Qxc6+! White sacrifices the queen with check, tempting a black pawn to capture and opening the a6-c8 diagonal.

moves.popup: 黑兵bxc6被迫吃后，走到c6，b7格被清空，对角线打开了。
moves.popup_en: bxc6. The pawn is forced to capture the queen on c6, vacating b7 and opening the diagonal.

moves.popup: 白象Ba6#，博登杀！双象从两条对角线交叉将死王，无处可逃。
moves.popup_en: Ba6# is Boden's mate! The two bishops attack the king along crossing diagonals, leaving no escape.
